title: SAUCE HUB
features:
SAUCE HUB - the all in-one script for Fight The Monsters: Restored. Clean purple UI, full mobile support, and a key system with a FREE 24 hour key (unlimited re gens) or lifetime access.

For More Info - https://saucehub.cc

== FEATURES ==

[ FARM ]
- Multi-select any mobs and auto-farm them
- Auto Farm Mobs with live status (weapon, target HP/DMG/speed, drops, session kill counter)
- Dodge Boss AoE (auto-avoid boss ground attacks)
- Auto Equip Weapon / strongest weapon
- Strafe + height offset tuning

[ BOSSES ]
- Every rarity: Common, Rare, Epic, Legendary, Secret
- One-click Teleport to any boss
- Live boss stats + spawned/not-spawned status, refresh

[ QUESTS ]
- Auto Accept, Auto Turn In, Auto Farm the quest target
- Daily / Weekly / Monthly bounty tracker
- Refresh bounty board

[ NPCs ]
- Quest Givers list with teleport
- Auto Do Quest - runs the full progression chain for you

[ ITEMS ]
- Bulk sell: Sell Items / Sell Selected

[ ARMORS ]
- Auto Equip All Armor
- Auto Equip Strongest
- Buy Armor

[ SHOPS ]
- Buy any Weapon, Potion, or Merchant item
- Teleport to merchant

[ BONE WORLD ]
- Live progression tracker (bone swords owned, next weapon, kill target, next portal)
- Go To Bone World
- Auto Farm nearest enemy
- Auto Progress - farms the exact enemy for your next sword, then walks the portal chain
- Area / portal teleporter

[ CONFIG ]
- Save / load your settings

[ QUALITY OF LIFE ]
- Search across all tabs
- Draggable, resizable, collapsible sidebar + minimize
- Full mobile support with auto-fit scaling
- Key system: free 24h key (unlimited) or lifetime

Works on PC and mobile executors. Enjoy!
